question: What forms of being may one attain through this practice?
premises: One may become a divine maiden of the gods.
One may also become a yakṣa-vidyādhara.
Both are stated as possible results.
inference: Through this practice one may attain the form of a divine maiden of the gods or of a yakṣa-vidyādhara.
plain_english: One may become a divine maiden of the gods, and also a yakṣa-vidyādhara.
